purpose: Evaluate actual rendered substitution quality, not face-label agreement.
source_decision: Both Poppler and PDFium candidate source-owned grayscale MSE <= current baseline + 1e-8, with unchanged thresholded topology; same character; source-supported emitted donor. No oracle images used.

oracle_outcome.safe_relative: Both renderers pristine MSE increase <= 0.002 normalized by pristine ink mass; binary core IoU decline <= 0.01; absolute ink-area bias increase <= 0.02.
oracle_outcome.material_regression_flag: Either renderer pristine MSE increase > 0.02 OR binary core IoU decline > 0.05. Flag for independent visual inspection, not automatic proof of changed character.
oracle_outcome.ambiguous: Anything between safe_relative and material_regression_flag; abstain from automatic promotion. Topology mismatches recorded separately because one antialiased pixel can open a counter.
oracle_outcome.absolute_quality: Baseline and candidate pristine errors are both reported; relative non-regression does not establish pristine or correct typography.

face_labels: Diagnostic only. Different-face substitutions are not counted wrong when rendered shapes are interchangeable.
damage: D0/D1 healthy reuse only here. D2-D4 preserved for a separate repair arm.
clarification_after_independent_review: Topology refers to candidate-versus-current baseline in frozen source-decision files. Pristine-relative topology was not measured. This clarification does not change the frozen limits or decisions; the original pre-oracle protocol remains hash-addressed locally.
